stops.name: Zugspitze
stops.detail: Every child in Bavaria knows that at 2,962 metres, the Zugspitze is the highest mountain in Germany. Two hundred years ago, however, even the adult population was unsure about this. So King Maximilian I commissioned his “Royal Bavarian Topographical Bureau” to measure the whole Werdenfelser region, along with the Zugspitze.
